kind: passive measurement feasibility and reproduction check; not confirmatory
scope: All external incoming lanes controlled by the three actual signals; no selection based on effect size.
E1: Instantaneous loop at the exact end of each incoming lane. Front-entry timestamps, sorted per lane, define crossings and headways; reported gap is not a headway. Track non-longitudinal leaves and terminal censoring separately.
E2: Last min(100m, lane length), 1s aggregation, speed threshold 5/3.6 m/s, time threshold 1s, jam gap threshold 10m. Detector-limited jam length is not the full upstream back-of-queue.
signals: Actual per-step TLS output, not edge-union or assumed green fractions. Protected G and permissive g kept separate; heterogeneous shared lanes excluded from phase-normalized comparisons.
cycle_scope: Complete observed phase-0-to-phase-0 cycles only, no warm-up removed. Boundary-truncated cycles reported separately. Do not claim steady state from this pilot.
headway_scope: Any green-window headways are observed operational headways, not saturation headways. Full queue-present, start-up and downstream-blocking validation remains required.
invariance: Require exact match of inserted, arrived, running, waiting, teleport counts and completed-trip outputs with corresponding passive-free baseline.
interpretation: This pilot validates instrumentation; it does not validate field capacity or the legacy proxy.
